Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): cane_1 + = Cane 1 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); cane_2 + = Cane 2 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); cane_3 + = Cane 3 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); cane_4 + = Cane 4 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); rustle_1a + = Leaf brick a of cane 1 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_1b + = Leaf brick b of cane 1 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_2a + = Leaf brick a of cane 2 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_2b + = Leaf brick b of cane 2 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_3a + = Leaf brick a of cane 3 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_3b + = Leaf brick b of cane 3 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_4a + = Leaf brick a of cane 4 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane; rustle_4b + = Leaf brick b of cane 4 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the cane.

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
